product: Genie Migrate conversion to Lakeflow pipelines is generally available
tagline: Genie Migrate conversion of T SQL scripts from SQL Server and Azure Synapse dedicated SQL pools into Lakeflow pipelines is now generally available.
what_it_does: Genie Migrate conversion of T SQL scripts from SQL Server and Azure Synapse dedicated SQL pools into Lakeflow pipelines is now generally available. In a T SQL migration project, choose the Spark Declarative Pipelines target framework, organize your files into groups, and choose a catalog and schema for each group. Each group becomes one serverless pipeline that Genie Migrate validates with a dry run.
why_it_matters: Supported source dialects and target frameworks Genie Migrate converts the following SQL dialects: T SQL Snowflake SQL Redshift SQL Oracle BigQuery Teradata When you create a migration project for a SQL dialect, choose one of the following target frameworks: DBSQL: ANSI compliant Databricks SQL queries.
